GOBD_COMPLIANCE.description: GoBD (Grundsaetze ordnungsmaessiger Buchfuehrung) digital record-keeping compliance
GOBD_COMPLIANCE.implementation_notes: Ensure immutable audit trail. Configure document archiving per GoBD. Retention period 10 years. Verfahrensdokumentation.

EU_GDPR_RETENTION.description: EU General Data Protection Regulation data retention and erasure policies
EU_GDPR_RETENTION.sap_transaction: SPRO > SAP ILM > Data Retention / Information Lifecycle Mgmt
EU_GDPR_RETENTION.implementation_notes: Configure retention periods per data class. Implement right-to-erasure. Block personal data after retention. DPIA documentation.

DATEV_EXPORT.description: DATEV interface export for German tax advisors — accounting data in DATEV format
DATEV_EXPORT.implementation_notes: Configure DATEV export format. Map SAP accounts to DATEV SKR03/SKR04. Monthly/annual data transfer. Include header/transaction files.

SEPA_PAYMENTS.description: Single Euro Payments Area credit transfer and direct debit configuration
SEPA_PAYMENTS.sap_transaction: FBZP > SEPA Payment Methods / SPRO > SEPA
SEPA_PAYMENTS.implementation_notes: Configure SEPA CT (pain.001) and DD (pain.008). Maintain IBAN/BIC. Handle mandate management for direct debits. SDD B2B vs CORE.

HGB_RETENTION.description: Handelsgesetzbuch (German Commercial Code) document retention periods — 6/10 year rules
HGB_RETENTION.implementation_notes: Commercial letters: 6 years. Accounting docs: 10 years. Configure archiving objects. Link to SAP ILM.

ELSTER_FILING.description: ELSTER (ELektronische STeuerERklaerung) electronic tax return submission to Finanzamt
ELSTER_FILING.implementation_notes: Configure ELSTER certificate. Electronic UStVA submission. Annual returns. Integrate with ERiC library.

UST_VA_RETURN.description: Umsatzsteuervoranmeldung — monthly/quarterly German VAT advance return
UST_VA_RETURN.implementation_notes: Map tax codes to UStVA reporting lines. Monthly submission by 10th. Quarterly if < EUR 7,500 annual VAT.

INTRASTAT_REPORTING.description: Intrastat declaration for intra-EU goods movements exceeding reporting thresholds
INTRASTAT_REPORTING.implementation_notes: Configure commodity codes (CN8). Track dispatch/arrival thresholds. Monthly filing to DESTATIS. Handle triangulation.

GERMAN_PAYROLL_SI.description: German social insurance — health, pension, unemployment, nursing care, and accident insurance
GERMAN_PAYROLL_SI.implementation_notes: Configure contribution rates (employer/employee shares). Beitragsbemessungsgrenze limits. Mini-job and Midi-job rules.

E_BILANZ.description: E-Bilanz (electronic balance sheet) XBRL taxonomy filing to tax authorities
E_BILANZ.implementation_notes: Map GL accounts to E-Bilanz taxonomy. Generate XBRL file. HGB-Taxonomie 6.x. Mandatory fields coverage.

KASSENSICHV_TSE.description: KassenSichV / TSE (Technical Security Equipment) for point-of-sale cash register compliance
KASSENSICHV_TSE.implementation_notes: Configure TSE device connection. Sign every transaction. Generate DSFinV-K export. Cloud TSE vs hardware TSE.

INTRASTAT_EU.description: Intrastat declaration for intra-EU goods movements — dispatches and arrivals reporting
INTRASTAT_EU.implementation_notes: Monthly filing per member state thresholds. CN8 commodity codes. Transaction nature. Delivery terms. Partner member state.

OSS_IOSS_VAT.description: One Stop Shop (OSS/IOSS) — simplified VAT registration for cross-border B2C EU sales
OSS_IOSS_VAT.implementation_notes: Union OSS for B2C goods/services within EU. Import OSS for consignments < EUR 150. Quarterly return to member state of identification.

GDPR_DATA_RETENTION.description: GDPR-compliant data retention policies, consent management, and right-to-erasure processes
GDPR_DATA_RETENTION.sap_transaction: SPRO > SAP ILM > GDPR / Data Protection
GDPR_DATA_RETENTION.implementation_notes: Define purpose-based retention. Implement blocking and deletion. Consent records. Data subject access requests. Cross-border transfer rules.

REVERSE_CHARGE_MECHANISM.description: EU reverse charge mechanism — shifting VAT liability to recipient for cross-border B2B supplies
REVERSE_CHARGE_MECHANISM.sap_transaction: SPRO > Tax on Sales/Purchases > Reverse Charge
REVERSE_CHARGE_MECHANISM.implementation_notes: Auto-apply reverse charge for intra-EU B2B. Self-assessment of VAT by buyer. Input/output tax posting. Domestic reverse charge sectors.

PEPPOL_E_INVOICING.description: PEPPOL (Pan-European Public Procurement OnLine) e-invoicing network for B2G and B2B
PEPPOL_E_INVOICING.implementation_notes: UBL 2.1 or CII format. Access point registration. PEPPOL ID for routing. Mandatory for EU public sector. Expanding to B2B.

SALES_USE_TAX.description: Multi-jurisdiction sales and use tax determination across 11,000+ US tax jurisdictions
SALES_USE_TAX.sap_transaction: SPRO > Financial Accounting > Tax on Sales/Purchases
SALES_USE_TAX.implementation_notes: Integrate with external tax engine (Vertex/Avalara). Handle nexus rules, exemption certificates, product taxability.

VERTEX_INTEGRATION_PARAMS.description: Vertex O Series tax engine integration parameters for real-time tax calculation
VERTEX_INTEGRATION_PARAMS.implementation_notes: Configure RFC to Vertex. Map SAP tax codes to Vertex. Handle tax-only adjustments. Batch vs real-time mode.

SOX_AUDIT_LOGGING.description: Sarbanes-Oxley Section 404 audit trail and change logging for financial controls
SOX_AUDIT_LOGGING.sap_transaction: SM19/SM20 > Security Audit Log / SPRO > SOX Controls
SOX_AUDIT_LOGGING.implementation_notes: Enable change documents for all financial master data. Configure audit trail for journal entries. Segregation of duties.

GAAP_GL_ACCOUNTS.description: US GAAP chart of accounts structure and parallel ledger configuration
GAAP_GL_ACCOUNTS.implementation_notes: Maintain US GAAP CoA. Configure parallel ledger (2L) for IFRS. Map local to group chart. ASC topic alignment.

FORM_1099_REPORTING.description: IRS 1099-MISC/NEC/INT reporting for vendor payments exceeding thresholds
FORM_1099_REPORTING.implementation_notes: Classify vendors as 1099-reportable. Maintain W-9 data. Generate 1099 forms. E-file via FIRE system. Track thresholds.

OFAC_SCREENING.description: Office of Foreign Assets Control sanctions screening for vendor/customer compliance
OFAC_SCREENING.sap_transaction: SPRO > SAP GTS > Sanctioned Party List
OFAC_SCREENING.implementation_notes: Integrate with SAP GTS or third-party screening. Check SDN list. Block transactions on match. Maintain audit log.

W2_W4_W9_FORMS.description: Employee W-2/W-4 and vendor W-9 tax form configuration and generation
W2_W4_W9_FORMS.implementation_notes: Configure W-4 withholding tables. Generate W-2 year-end. Store W-9 for vendors. Handle state equivalents.

FICA_FUTA_TAX.description: Federal Insurance Contributions Act (Social Security/Medicare) and Federal Unemployment Tax
FICA_FUTA_TAX.implementation_notes: Configure wage base limits. Handle Additional Medicare Tax (0.9%). FUTA credit reduction states. Multi-state employees.

ACH_EDI_PAYMENTS.description: Automated Clearing House electronic payment configuration with EDI 820/835 formats
ACH_EDI_PAYMENTS.sap_transaction: FBZP > Payment Methods / SPRO > Payment Medium
ACH_EDI_PAYMENTS.implementation_notes: Configure ACH payment method. Map bank formats (NACHA). Handle prenotes. EDI 820 remittance advice.

ASC_842_LEASES.description: ASC 842 lease accounting — right-of-use asset and lease liability recognition
ASC_842_LEASES.sap_transaction: SPRO > RE-FX > Lease Accounting / S/4HANA Lease Contracts
ASC_842_LEASES.implementation_notes: Classify operating vs finance leases. Calculate ROU asset and liability. Handle modifications, remeasurements, variable payments.

ASC_606_REVENUE.description: ASC 606 five-step revenue recognition model for contract-based revenue
ASC_606_REVENUE.implementation_notes: Configure performance obligations. Allocate transaction price. Recognize over time vs point-in-time. Handle variable consideration.

STATE_PAYROLL_TAX.description: State-level income tax withholding, SUI, SDI, and local tax configuration for all 50 states
STATE_PAYROLL_TAX.implementation_notes: Maintain state withholding tables. Handle reciprocity agreements. Configure SUI rates per state. Local taxes (NYC, PA localities).

FATCA_REPORTING.description: Foreign Account Tax Compliance Act reporting for foreign financial accounts
FATCA_REPORTING.implementation_notes: Identify US persons with foreign accounts. Generate FATCA reports. Handle W-8BEN forms for foreign vendors.

ECONOMIC_NEXUS.description: Post-Wayfair economic nexus threshold tracking across all US states
ECONOMIC_NEXUS.implementation_notes: Track revenue and transaction count per state. Alert on threshold approach ($100K/200 transactions). Auto-register for tax.

NOTA_FISCAL_ELETRONICA.description: NF-e (Nota Fiscal Eletronica) electronic invoice issuance and SEFAZ authorization
NOTA_FISCAL_ELETRONICA.implementation_notes: Configure digital certificate (A1/A3). SEFAZ communication. Handle contingency modes (DPEC, FS-DA). NF-e layout 4.0.

SPED_REPORTING.description: SPED (Sistema Publico de Escrituracao Digital) — ECD, ECF, EFD-ICMS/IPI reporting
SPED_REPORTING.implementation_notes: Generate SPED Fiscal (EFD-ICMS/IPI). SPED Contabil (ECD). SPED ECF for corporate income tax. Block/register codes.

ICMS_TAX_CONFIG.description: ICMS (Imposto sobre Circulacao de Mercadorias e Servicos) state-level tax configuration
ICMS_TAX_CONFIG.implementation_notes: Configure inter-state vs intra-state rates. ICMS-ST (substituicao tributaria). DIFAL calculation. Tax benefits/incentives.

PIS_COFINS_CONFIG.description: PIS/COFINS federal social contribution tax — cumulative and non-cumulative regimes
PIS_COFINS_CONFIG.implementation_notes: Configure regime type per company. Credit calculation for non-cumulative. Map NCM to PIS/COFINS rates. EFD-Contribuicoes.

CNPJ_CPF_VALIDATION.description: CNPJ (corporate) and CPF (individual) tax ID validation for all business partners
CNPJ_CPF_VALIDATION.implementation_notes: Validate CNPJ (14 digits) and CPF (11 digits) check digits. Block master creation without valid ID. Inscricao Estadual.

NCM_PRODUCT_CODES.description: NCM (Nomenclatura Comum do Mercosul) product classification codes for tax determination
NCM_PRODUCT_CODES.implementation_notes: Maintain NCM at material master. 8-digit code. Drives IPI, PIS/COFINS, ICMS rates. Map to TIPI table.

CFOP_OPERATION_CODES.description: CFOP (Codigo Fiscal de Operacoes e Prestacoes) operation codes for NF-e
CFOP_OPERATION_CODES.implementation_notes: 4-digit codes indicating operation nature. Map SAP movement types to CFOPs. Handle returns, transfers, exports.

IRRF_WITHHOLDING.description: IRRF (Imposto de Renda Retido na Fonte) income tax withholding on payments
IRRF_WITHHOLDING.sap_transaction: SPRO > Financial Accounting > Withholding Tax > Brazil
IRRF_WITHHOLDING.implementation_notes: Configure withholding rates per service type. Handle progressive table for individuals. DIRF annual declaration.

DARF_PAYMENT.description: DARF (Documento de Arrecadacao de Receitas Federais) federal tax payment voucher generation
DARF_PAYMENT.implementation_notes: Generate DARF for IRPJ, CSLL, PIS, COFINS, IPI. Calculate penalties and interest for late payment. Bar code generation.

ESOCIAL_REPORTING.description: eSocial digital bookkeeping for labor, social security, and tax obligations
ESOCIAL_REPORTING.implementation_notes: Submit employment events (S-2200, S-1200, etc.). Real-time CAGED replacement. Configure event-driven transmission.

EFD_REINF.description: EFD-Reinf (Escrituracao Fiscal Digital das Retencoes e Informacoes) withholding reporting
EFD_REINF.implementation_notes: Report service withholdings (R-2010, R-2020). Replaces DIRF partially. Monthly digital bookkeeping. DCTFWeb integration.

J_1B_TABLES.description: SAP J_1B* Brazil localization tables maintenance — tax laws, CFOP, NCM updates
J_1B_TABLES.implementation_notes: Maintain J_1BATL (tax law), J_1BNCM (NCM codes), J_1BCFOP (CFOP). Regular updates required for legislative changes.

GST_SETUP.description: Goods and Services Tax configuration — tax procedures, condition types (JIIG, JICG, JISG), and tax code mapping
GST_SETUP.sap_transaction: SPRO > Tax on Goods Movements > India > GST
GST_SETUP.implementation_notes: Requires TAXINN procedure. Map all CGST/SGST/IGST condition types. Verify HSN-based determination.

TDS_CONFIG.description: Tax Deducted at Source — withholding tax types, codes, and certificate generation per Section 194/195
TDS_CONFIG.sap_transaction: SPRO > Financial Accounting > Withholding Tax > Extended Withholding Tax
TDS_CONFIG.implementation_notes: Configure both classic and extended WHT. Map TDS sections to WHT types. Ensure challan 281 setup.

E_INVOICE_API.description: E-Invoicing API integration with NIC/IRP portal for B2B invoice registration and IRN generation
E_INVOICE_API.implementation_notes: Requires API credentials from NIC. Configure JSON payload mapping. Handle IRN cancellation within 24h window.

E_WAY_BILL.description: E-Way Bill generation for goods transport exceeding INR 50,000 threshold
E_WAY_BILL.implementation_notes: Integrate with NIC API. Auto-generate on delivery note. Validate Part A/B data. Handle multi-vehicle scenarios.

PAN_VALIDATION.description: Permanent Account Number validation for vendors and customers during master data creation
PAN_VALIDATION.implementation_notes: Validate PAN format (AAAAA0000A). Cross-check with GSTIN 3rd-12th characters. Block posting without valid PAN.

GSTIN_VALIDATION.description: GSTIN (15-digit) validation and state code cross-referencing for all business partners
GSTIN_VALIDATION.implementation_notes: Validate checksum digit. Match state code to plant/customer state. Support SEZ and composition dealers.

HSN_SAC_CODES.description: Harmonized System of Nomenclature / Service Accounting Codes for GST rate determination
HSN_SAC_CODES.sap_transaction: SPRO > Logistics General > Tax on Goods Movements > India > HSN/SAC
HSN_SAC_CODES.implementation_notes: Maintain HSN at material master level. SAC codes for service materials. Map to correct GST rate slabs (5/12/18/28%).

GSTR_FILING.description: GSTR-1, GSTR-2A/2B reconciliation, and GSTR-3B return data extraction
GSTR_FILING.implementation_notes: Extract outward supply data for GSTR-1. Reconcile inward supplies with GSTR-2A. Compute net liability for GSTR-3B.

PF_ESI_CONFIG.description: Provident Fund and Employee State Insurance payroll deduction configuration
PF_ESI_CONFIG.implementation_notes: Configure PF wage ceiling (INR 15,000). ESI threshold (INR 21,000). Handle voluntary PF contributions. UAN integration.

PROFESSIONAL_TAX.description: State-wise Professional Tax slab configuration for payroll deduction
PROFESSIONAL_TAX.implementation_notes: Different slabs per state (MH, KA, WB, etc.). Monthly deduction. Annual max INR 2,500. Maintain state-wise tables.

AADHAAR_INTEGRATION.description: Aadhaar number storage and validation for employee/vendor KYC compliance
AADHAAR_INTEGRATION.implementation_notes: Store encrypted. Validate 12-digit format with Verhoeff checksum. Link to PAN for Income Tax compliance.

TCS_SETUP.description: Tax Collected at Source configuration for sellers under Section 206C
TCS_SETUP.sap_transaction: SPRO > Financial Accounting > Withholding Tax > TCS
TCS_SETUP.implementation_notes: Configure TCS on sale of goods exceeding INR 50 lakh. Different rates per category. Quarterly TCS return.

RCM_CONFIG.description: Reverse Charge Mechanism configuration for specified goods/services under GST
RCM_CONFIG.sap_transaction: SPRO > India Localization > GST > Reverse Charge
RCM_CONFIG.implementation_notes: Identify RCM-applicable supplies. Auto-post input/output tax. Handle partial RCM. Monthly ITC claim.

ITC_RULES.description: Input Tax Credit eligibility rules, blocked credits, and proportionate ITC reversal
ITC_RULES.sap_transaction: SPRO > India Localization > GST > ITC Rules
ITC_RULES.implementation_notes: Implement Rule 42/43 for proportionate reversal. Block ITC on specified items (motor vehicles, food, etc.).
